l.i: Huius ad exemplar dum nobis, docte Salusti,
Sic, fateor, nobis mundus non nascitur alter:
Sic nobis totum enarras diuinitus, alter
Hinc prior Vt mundi primis natalibus orta,
Sic tua posterior natalibus orta secundis,

main_text.head: IN CL. V. STEPHANI PASCASII, in Senatu Parisiensi Aduocati, imaginem, manibus carentem.

p.i: QVàm bene, Pascasi, tua qui depinxerat ora,
Seruati ore tuo nam quum sint mille clientes,
Nemo ex mille tibi sensit adesse manus.

main_text.head: In Symbolũ CL. V. IACOBI MONAVII, patricii Vratislauiensis,
DEVS FACIET.

p.i: PRomissi Deus est auctor: quidnam ambigis amens?
Promittente opus est sint rata cuncta Deo.

page.notes: Ornamental initial letters Q and P are large woodcut-style initials. The heading "In Symbolũ" and the first verse lines are partly damaged at the left edge; "Promittente" and "Pro" readings are uncertain. Line 2 of the second epigram reads "Addendas picto" as printed. A stray pen-like mark at the lower right is not text.
